evidence.question: VariabelRegister_Källa is “Enkäten Innovationsverksamher 2002-2004” (sic) and the native edition is “2002 - 2004”. The answer meanings come from the wave's own questionnaire, question 13 (“Markera vilken typ av samarbetspartner ni hade samt dess lokalisering”), rows a–g by four locations. SWECOV's CIS2004 holdings name the answers co<row><location> by questionnaire position: the maintainer's aggregate MONA check (2026-10-14) found the 4-location waves (CIS2004, CIS2006) carry co11–co14 with no co15, so the location digit is the questionnaire column, and partner rows a–e have the same meaning under positional and later-wave readings. Only rows a–e are declared: co6x/co7x are held (#1571) because their partner meaning is not established for this wave, and no other cell is asserted. SCB's quality declaration Appendix 2 (uf0315_kd_2018_ah_191113.pdf, pp. 23–27) lists this wave's questionnaire items on the same rows but names no co columns for it.
